artifacts.notes: The archive URL, https://press.vatican.va/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_const_19631204_sacrosanctum-concilium_lt.html, and https://www.vatican.va/content/dam/wss/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_const_19631204_sacrosanctum-concilium_lt.html returned byte-identical 89918-byte responses with this SHA-256 on 2026-07-23. This artifact owns that one byte identity; the alias routes are not duplicated. The response contains Latin articles 1-130, the appended declaration on revision of the calendar, the promulgation formula, a subscription block, the Vacatio legis notice, and source notes. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.

work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Constitution on the Sacred Liturgy, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 4 December 1963. It comprises articles 1-130 and the appended declaration on revision of the calendar; edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
